text: A shirtless male figure with fair skin, appearing adult, has a muscular build. His blonde hair is shoulder-length, wavy, and styled in soft curls. He has a broad face with defined cheekbones, prominent blue eyes, and thick dark eyebrows. Large gold hoop earrings adorn his ears. He stands upright, facing slightly left, gazing forward. In the foreground, a terracotta vessel with decorative patterns rests beside him. Behind, ropes hang from stone structures under a dusky sky.
